notes.title: Welcome to Shadows in Silence!
notes.content:
Hello there! 

We present to your attention our new game - an asymmetrical horror game in which you can hunt as a witch and her faithful pet cat Sharm, or play as survivors to try to beat and destroy the killer.

Our plans are to conduct a beta test in the near future. We are now in the final phase of preparation for it.

If you’d like to join us in this journey, please follow us, or add our game to your wishlist.

And stay tuned for news and announcements on the Shadows in Silence Game page. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1PBXt7c.gif[/img]

Thank you all,
Room710Games team.
